name: Commit & push
description: Pause for approval, make one AI-written commit, then pause again before pushing.

steps.title: Generate commit message
steps.prompt: Stage my changes with `nomoreide_git_stage` (skip anything that looks like a secret, e.g. `.env`), inspect the staged diff once with `nomoreide_git_staged_diff`, then write one conventional-commit message — a `<type>: concise title` line (feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/test) plus a few short bullets of what changed. Do NOT commit. Reply with ONLY the commit message you recommend.

steps.title: Approve commit
steps.message: Stage the current changes and create one AI-written commit?

name: Ship it
description: Approve the AI commit, push, then use quick AI turns to open and squash-merge the PR.

steps.title: Generate commit message
steps.prompt: Stage my changes with `nomoreide_git_stage` (skip anything that looks like a secret, e.g. `.env`), inspect the staged diff once with `nomoreide_git_staged_diff`, then write one conventional-commit message — a `<type>: concise title` line (feat/fix/refactor/chore/docs/test) plus a few short bullets of what changed. Do NOT commit. Reply with ONLY the commit message you recommend.

steps.title: Approve commit
steps.message: Stage the current changes and create one AI-written commit?

steps.title: Open a PR
steps.prompt: Open a PR for the current branch into `main` using the `nomoreide_github_create_pr` tool. Title = the latest commit subject; for the body, list the commits via `nomoreide_git_log`. Do NOT read file diffs. Reply with just the PR number and URL.

steps.title: Squash-merge
steps.prompt: Squash-merge the open pull request for the current branch. First call `nomoreide_git_status` for the branch name, then `nomoreide_github_list_prs` to find its open PR, then merge it with `nomoreide_github_merge_pr`. Don't analyze anything else — just find it and merge. Reply with one line.

name: File an issue from these changes
description: One quick AI turn drafts a short issue from your file list, then files it on approval.

steps.title: Draft a short issue
steps.prompt: Draft a SHORT GitHub issue (a title + a 2–3 line body) from the list of changed files only — call `nomoreide_git_status` for the file list. Do NOT read file diffs or analyze the changes. Show me the draft; don't file it.

steps.title: File the issue
steps.prompt: Create the GitHub issue you just drafted using the `nomoreide_github_create_issue` tool. Reply with just the issue number and URL.
